result:
The configured value takes effect in commit `4cc27d388fb4a4fe49316791a20127dbb04e31ae` (PR #1920, "(fix) O3-6028: Pass `locationsPerRequest` to the login location picker and drop `numberToShow`"). The line that passes it is `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker-view.component.tsx:181`:

```tsx
locationsPerRequest={Math.max(chooseLocation.locationsPerRequest, 1)}
```

Before this change, the login view did not pass the setting, so the picker's default of 50 was used. The picker's default is still in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/location-picker/location-picker.component.tsx:27`, and it now only applies when no value is passed. The login view clamps the value to at least 1, so a configured 0 becomes 1. The test file `openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/location-picker/location-picker.test.tsx:435-457` checks that a configured 5 reaches the picker and that 0 falls back to 1. The same commit also removed the unused `chooseLocation.numberToShow` option. The changeset `openmrs-esm-core/.changeset/login-locations-per-request.md` records the fix.

Falkon's provenance lookup returned no ticket key for the commit, so the ticket is taken from the commit subject.
